subtests.name: change event fires when the container size crosses the query boundary.
onchange event handler attribute receives change events.
No change event fires for the initial evaluation.
No change event fires when the match state does not change.
No change event fires when the state reverts within the same rendering opportunity.
Exactly one change event fires per state transition.
Reading matches before the rendering steps does not suppress the change event.
change event fires when a style query result changes.
change event fires when the target is removed from and re-inserted into the tree.
Multiple lists on the same element each receive their own change event.
change event fires when a closer ancestor becomes the query container.
change event fires for a container change made inside a hidden subtree once revealed.
change event fires when a hidden ancestor container becomes rendered.
change event fires when slot reassignment changes the flat-tree container.
change event fires when moveBefore() changes the query container.
change event fires after the target is adopted into another document and changes again there.
No change event fires while the target is in a document that is not fully active.
